failure_chain.diagnosis: Run task is arc-bench-lite--keep, but internal acceptance selected arc-bench-web--keep after finding no spec files in /workspace/tests. The 29/32 internal result therefore validated a different contract and allowed the final Lite package to proceed without matching self-acceptance.

failure_chain.observed: The final test waited for button Note trashed and timed out.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The template performs DELETE /api/notes/:id and calls showStatus('Note deleted', undoDelete); the status is a role=status container with an Undo button, not a button named Note trashed. The mutation path exists, but the rendered accessible status does not match the executed test contract.

failure_chain.observed: Archive tests could not find a per-note button named exactly Archive; Change note color could not find a per-note button named exactly Change color.
failure_chain.diagnosis: noteCard renders the existing-note controls as Archive note and Background options. The backend archive/color PATCH handlers and the composer Change color control exist, but the final per-note accessible names do not match the final locators. The archive failures are therefore not evidence that the PATCH implementation itself is absent.

failure_chain.observed: REQ-2.7.1/2.7.2 timed out while looking for Work in Note editor; REQ-2.7.4 found Call dentist created but its text did not contain Reminders.
failure_chain.diagnosis: For existing notes, the template opens a separate dialog labelled Label editor and places the checkboxes there, while the executed locators scope them to Note editor. This is a direct test/template contract mismatch. Separately, the final db seed contains Reminders on Call dentist created, but noteCard does not render note.labels, so the REQ-2.7.4 visible-card assertion cannot pass even when persistence succeeds.

failure_chain.observed: Both tests timed out while checking title Pinned on the matching article.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The design precondition for REQ-2.8.1 requires Meeting agenda 2.8.1 to start unpinned, but final db.json has it pinned=true. The create scenario title Meeting agenda created also already exists and is pinned=true, so first-match selection can resolve the seed note rather than the newly created note. The package-state mismatch is confirmed; the exact browser selection sequence is unavailable, so the individual timeout attribution remains a strong candidate.

failure_chain.observed: The final test waited for a button named Reminders inside the listbox.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The template creates each search suggestion with role=option, not a button role. The listbox and label filtering handler exist, but the accessible role does not match the executed locator.

failure_chain.observed: The final tests could not find a button named exactly Settings.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The template top-level settings button has aria-label Settings menu, while the settings menuitem is named Settings. Consequently the final test cannot open the menu through the required button, and the detailed-settings test cannot reach its menuitem step.

generation_process_findings.finding: Task suite routing was not fail-closed: an arc-bench-web suite was selected for an arc-bench-lite run after no specs were found in /workspace/tests.
The generation flow spent 5 implementation turns at the 900-second cap and used 13 request-budget guards; late repairs did not converge before the final package was produced.
One proxy unexpected EOF and 402 postflight stray processes were recorded. They are runtime hygiene risks, but no evidence proves they independently caused the 14 final UI timeouts.

excluded_causes: Not an entrypoint or application-start failure: main.py ran, frontend build passed, backend listened on port 3000, and the final suite reached the application.
Not a global platform time-budget exhaustion: the run ended after 20611 seconds against a 48000-second agent budget.
Not an OOM/cgroup failure: no OOM kill or cgroup termination was evidenced.
Not sufficient evidence for 14 independent backend defects: several failures are direct accessible-name/role mismatches, and the pin failures have seed-state contamination.
Not a plaintext API key leak: the evidence contains only masked/set environment status.

Platform-native screenshots, traces, HAR and error-context bodies are unavailable, so exact initial DOM and browser selection order cannot be reconstructed.
No task_snapshot_id, build_id, commit SHA or platform upload ZIP binding is available.
No clean-seed before/after hash proves whether the final browser run started from the intended deterministic database.

stage5_recommendation.classification: confirmed harness suite-routing gap plus confirmed UI accessibility/rendering gaps plus strong seed-state candidates
actions: 先将内部 acceptance 改为 task-key 严格匹配；找不到 arc-bench-lite--keep spec 时 fail closed，禁止选择 arc-bench-web--keep。
在同一 Lite suite 上修正并验证精确 accessible names/roles：Archive、Change color、Note trashed、Settings 和 search suggestion button。
确认 label editor 的官方契约后，保持对话框结构与 locator 一致；补齐 note card 的 label 可见呈现。
清理并固定 pin 场景 seed：Meeting agenda 2.8.1 初始不置顶，Meeting agenda created 不预置。
缩短单节点 inspect -> patch -> targeted test 闭环，为 repair 保留硬预算；不要用错误 Web suite 的 29/32 绿灯作 Lite 结论。
阶段 5 不修改官方测试；完成隔离复现和同快照 A/B 后才考虑新平台 Run。
